selected_fixture_policy.name: authority_fixture_v1
selected_fixture_policy.scope: Original deterministic input policy only; no deployed policy is selected.
selected_fixture_policy.membership: Current exact organization/principal membership, recognized supported policy and requested domain/purpose are required. Names and cached hints grant nothing.
selected_fixture_policy.direct_reads: Current policy read-role membership permits exact same-workspace project reads, including direct own-key agent/service reads.
selected_fixture_policy.project_review: Direct human owner authority or the exact current selected own-key agent grant chain is required. Membership alone does not authorize an agent review.
selected_fixture_policy.chain: All immutable links and current principals, issuer memberships, policy and restrictions must agree. Child scope/actions/purposes/lifetime cannot expand parent authority; issuance is inclusive, expiry exclusive.
selected_fixture_policy.sources: Every required source policy must be recognized, active, unexpired and permit the current principal and purpose; intersect all policies.
selected_fixture_policy.effect: Admission decision alone changes no canonical state. Final-effect observations recheck current authority and exact requested target CAS before any consumer effect.
selected_fixture_policy.human_assurance: All cases issue no human assurance. Human kind, a key, grant or test mechanism never qualifies financial human review.
